data.one_liner: Flexible node-based flow editor for Flutter to build visual diagrams and workflows.
data.what_it_does: Provides a high-performance node-based flow editor for Flutter applications. It enables the creation of visual programming interfaces, workflow editors, interactive diagrams, and data pipelines with built-in support for pan, zoom, custom connections, and theming.
use_when: You need to build a visual workflow or data pipeline editor in Flutter.
You require a canvas supporting nodes, ports, custom connections, and minimaps.
avoid_when: You only need to display basic statistical charts like line, bar, or pie charts.
Your application does not involve node-graph or flowchart editing interfaces.
strengths: High-performance rendering optimized for smooth interactions and large graphs.
Comprehensive theming system and connection effects like particles and gradients.
Extensible via extensions like minimaps, stats overlays, and level of detail rendering.
weaknesses: Niche use-case focused primarily on node-based editors and diagrams.
Requires managing a custom controller state specific to node graphs.

alternatives.name: directed_graph
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need automated layout of directed graphs rather than an interactive node editor canvas.
